submission.title: MultiHopper Nexus Router - Solana Multi-Hop Smart Order Routing & Arbitrage Engine
submission.projectSummary: A production-grade Solana multi-hop split routing, arbitrage detection, and treasury execution engine that mathematically optimizes token swaps across Raydium, Orca, Meteora, and Phoenix using Yen's K-Shortest Path and SLSQP convex split optimization, natively piping proceeds into MultiHopper privacy-preserving multi-hop transfers and up to 20-recipient multi-destination treasury dispersion with TRM Labs compliance screening.

mathematicalModels: Raydium CLMM & Orca Whirlpool (Concentrated Liquidity with ticks and sqrtPriceX64)
Meteora DLMM (Discrete Dynamic Liquidity Bins with volatility fees)
Phoenix / Lifinity (Orderbook CFMM with proactive market making & inventory skew penalty)
Yen's K-Shortest Path (Loopless multi-hop graph routing in logarithmic cost space)
SLSQP Convex Split Optimization (Non-linear waterfilling across liquidity pools)
Bellman-Ford Cyclic Arbitrage Detection (Negative-cycle detection with net gas and priority fee accounting)
multihopperFeatures: Swaps-with-Hooks Pipeline (combining DEX execution with MultiHopper Core route deployment)
Multi-Destination Dispersion (up to 20 recipient wallets with exact proportional share allocations)
Automatic TRM Labs Screening (0.002 SOL per wallet fee integration)
Real-time 0.25% Integrator Revenue Calculation ($2,500 per $1M routed)
technicalOverview.testCoverage: 35 passing tests, 0 mocks, covering exact mathematical invariants, slippage curves, fee schedules, and transaction builder.

revenueAndVolumeModel.scaledPrizePool: $1,000 unlocked per additional $400k volume up to $50,000 USDC at $20M aggregate volume
revenueAndVolumeModel.prizeDistribution: Proportional share of funded pool based on qualifying volume among top 3 winners
